name: Ripley's Cross-L Function
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: At what distance cell type B accumulates around cell type A.
citation: Ripley, B. D. (1977). Modelling spatial patterns. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B, 39(2), 172-212.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help:
Selects the annotation used to define the groups.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: type_a
params.label: Group A (reference)
params.help:
Selects the reference group from which distances are measured.
Defaults to the most abundant group.

params.name: type_b
params.label: Group B (neighbour)
params.help:
Selects the group counted around group A.
Defaults to the next most abundant group; A and B must differ.

params.name: max_radius
params.label: Maximum radius
params.help:
Sets the largest distance tested, in the dataset’s coordinate units.
Keep it below about one quarter of the section’s shorter side to limit edge effects.

params.name: n_steps
params.label: Radius steps
params.help:
Sets how many radii are tested between the smallest radius and the maximum radius.
More steps produce a more detailed curve.

params.name: n_sims
params.label: Simulations
params.help:
Sets how many random redistributions of the B labels are used to create the grey envelope.
More simulations give a more stable envelope but increase runtime.

params.name: window
params.label: Observation window
params.help:
Defines the tissue area used to calculate density and correct for edges.
The convex hull suits irregular tissue, while the bounding box suits a rectangular imaging field.
